scripts.format: bunx prettier . --write --ignore-path .prettierignore; cd api; uvx ruff check --fix; uvx ruff format
scripts.typecheck: cd cli; bun run typecheck; cd ../api; uvx ty check
scripts.dev: (docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml ps -a --quiet | grep . >/dev/null || bun run dev:build); docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml up --watch
scripts.dev:clean: rm -rf node_modules; cd cli; rm -rf node_modules; cd ../api; rm -rf .venv
scripts.dev:install: bun install; cd cli; bun install; cd ../api; uv sync
